title: Stable Audio Open
hero_prompt: Two-color screenprint on dark ground, wide 12:5 format. A figure at a workbench — hands touching an oscilloscope-like surface — surrounded by frozen waveforms radiating outward like brushstrokes. The waveforms dissolve at the edges into texture and grain, never resolving into melody. Bold ink, flat color fields, halftone shadows. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
icon_prompt: Bold square emblem, dark background, two-color screenprint style. A single waveform arc that breaks into scattered grain at one end — the mark of a sound that reaches but does not complete. High contrast, heavy lines, survives at 24px. No letters, numerals, words, labels — purely pictorial.
